messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging: prod-gen2-high-latency at 2026-03-15T03:45:12Z — error rate spike + 95th latency > 3s. Paging on-call: @priya.
priya: Taking it. I’m attaching traces now. seeing KV-cache miss storms on embeddings route. starting tail on node logs.
alex: I can scale the kernels pool if needed. is this regional?
priya: Looks concentrated in us-west-2. Mateo, can you confirm autoscaler logs? @mateo
mateo: On it. autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups, hit quota on dedicated-gpu-pool, failed with API 403 for a few requests. Posting snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T03:42:51Z autoscaler: scale_attempt -> quota_exceeded (gpu-pool-limit)
2026-03-15T03:43:10Z runtime: kv-cache-eviction spike
```
kelsey: I see increased prefix-cache churn. probable regression from last runtime tweak rolled 02:30.
kevin: I initiated emergency rollback of runtime v2.14 -> v2.13 on impacted nodes, rolling over 6 nodes now.
priya: Good. I’m pausing traffic to fallback model variant for embeddings to reduce KV pressure. Routing rule: embeddings -> small-embed-quantized fallback.
sara: Customer impact: roughly 7% of requests returned 5xx, top affected customers = acme-corp, travelly. Latency window ~03:40–03:55 UTC. Ticketed CSMs.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback started (job id: rollback-1776001112-1). ETA ~4m.
priya: Monitoring — error rate dropping. keep an eye on regional queue depth. Alex: can you bump capacity request to infra for a short term emergency quota?
alex: DMing infra now. also left a note in #eng-infra.
mateo: Infra responded: provisional quota granted +2 GPUs to pool, but provisioning takes ~7m.
priya: For customer-facing update, what’s the minimal status page entry? Sara?
sara: Draft status page update ready: 
```
Incident: Increased latency and elevated error rates for embeddings in us-west-2.
Status: Mitigated — rollback and routing changes applied. Impact window: ~03:40–03:55 UTC.
Next: Full RCA and timeline will be posted within 48 hours. Contact: support@redwood.example
```
priya: Looks good. Please include note about in-flight requests possibly delayed. add: "some customers may have experienced failures or timeouts"
sara: Updated. posting to status page now.
cs-team-bot: Notifying CSMs for affected accounts: acme-corp, travelly, medfin. Template draft in #customer-comm.
kevin: Rollback completed on 6/6 nodes. metrics look back to baseline. Keeping watch for 15m.
priya: Handing off to @mateo for overnight mitigation monitoring and post-incident follow-up. Mate0? (typo) @mateo
mateo: Taking the handoff at 04:02 UTC. I'll keep 1hr shadow then create a short runbook note with steps taken.
priya: Thanks. Action items list — we need to capture these now:
- alex: open emergency infra quota request ticket for long-term validation (due: 2026-03-17)
- kevin: add automated rollback test to CI that verifies kernel change rollback path (due: 2026-03-22)
- mateo: write detailed runbook on KV-cache eviction diagnostics and mitigation steps (due: 2026-03-18)
- kelsey: gate future runtime tweaks with perf-canary on embeddings workload (due: 2026-03-20)
- sara: send initial customer-impact email to affected accounts and schedule RCA share (due: 2026-03-16)
priya: I’ve created a tracker in the incidents tracker spreadsheet and linked it to the postmortem doc.
priya: Scheduling postmortem: proposed slot 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC (30m). who’s required? eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, support, account exec.
alex: I’m in.
mateo: in.
kevin: in.
sara: in.
priya: Kelsey?
kelsey: can make it.
priya: Great. I created calendar invite and linked preliminary notes: https://calendar.example/event/pm-1776001112 (placeholder).
priya: Customer communication plan: sara will send initial note acknowledging incident and mitigation completed, offer a sync with technical lead and provide ETA for RCA. we should offer credits if SLA breached — finance OK to evaluate. @cs-team-bot please prepare standard credits template.
cs-team-bot: Credits template ready. will attach proposed credit amounts for affected customers in the draft.
sara: Draft email to customers (short):
"Hi — we experienced elevated latency and errors for embeddings in us-west-2 on 2026-03-15 03:40–03:55 UTC. We mitigated by rolling back a runtime change and applying routing fallbacks. We're running a full RCA and will share details within 48 hours. If this affected your production traffic, we can schedule a technical review and discuss remediation / credits. — Redwood Support"
priya: Good. please send after pm with subject line: "Incident Recap: embeddings latency — Mar 15". CC support and account execs.
mateo: Postmortem notes: preliminary root cause hypothesis = regression in kernel scheduling causing extreme KV-cache churn when combined with a specific embeddings traffic pattern that overwhelms autoscaler quota. Need better canary + quota guardrails.
kevin: Also add: improve alerting thresholds to correlate KV-cache eviction rate with autoscaler errors. current alert too generic.
alex: I'll draft an infra proposal for autoscaler grace capacity and quota monitoring.
priya: tagging owners on tracker. Once we have the RCA, we’ll publish to status page and send customers the detailed RCA PDF. Timeline: initial RCA summary within 48h; full RCA + remediation plan within 7 days.
sara: Noted. I’ll coordinate with CSMs for 1:1 outreach to top impacted accounts and offer a technical postmortem call.
mateo: Adding follow-ups to runbook: how to trigger emergency fallback routing, rollback commands, and how to request provisional quota from infra.
priya: Closing note — incident declared mitigated at 04:07 UTC. Monitoring window until 04:22 UTC then transitioning to post-incident. Thanks team. :heart:
ops-bot: Incident closed for paging at 04:07:12Z (mitigated). Postmortem meeting scheduled.
priya: I’ll open the postmortem doc now and paste chronological timeline + logs. Link: https://docs.example/postmortem/1776001112 (placeholder).
kevin: Added the rollback command snippet to the postmortem: 
```
# rollback runtime
redwood deploy rollback --env prod --component runtime --to v2.13
```
mateo: I'll own the action item tracker and post updates there daily until resolved.
priya: Thanks everyone. Final ask: if anyone finds new symptoms, re-open thread and ping @priya.
alex: Good job getting this stabilized quickly.
sara: Customer comms sent to affected CSMs; awaiting approvals for outward email.
priya: last_message: leaving final checklist in the doc: confirm RCA posted, customers emailed, action items assigned and due dates updated.
